plain_english_policy: Advocate for increased state funding for public K-12 schools, including targeted investments in early childhood education and teacher salaries. Propose a dedicated sales tax surcharge (0.5%) on non-essential retail to fund these priorities without raising income taxes.
evidence_quote: **‘My top priority is ensuring Alabama’s children receive a world-class education. I will push for a 10% annual increase in per-pupil funding and use a temporary 0.5% sales tax on luxury goods (e.g., jewelry, electronics) to close the $3B gap without burdening working families.**’**
review_reason: Explicitly progressive stance on education funding (increased spending + regressive revenue source) with no conservative offsets.
